name: template-media
body: Project media: fonts, logos, images, video and any other file type under the resolved library's `themes/<name>/` or `media/` are served by `kalide start` from the resolved library root (offline, 127.0.0.1 only) with a content type derived from the file extension; every media file type is served (there is no allow-list of media types). Reference rules: layouts reference shared media via `{{media "path"}}`, the path being relative to the resolved library's `media/` only and staying within it (requirements.constraint.media-paths-library-relative); theme-owned files (fonts, logos in `themes/<name>/`) are referenced only from that theme's `theme.css` via relative `url()` and are served from the theme directory; a theme's `theme.css` (and any CSS it `@import`s from its own theme directory) may additionally reference the library's shared `media/` tree with the reserved `media:` URL prefix, validated the same way and rewritten to the served media URL (theme-media-references) — the layout helper `media` resolves only within the library's `media/` tree, and a theme reaches only its own directory and that shared `media/` tree. AC: a `.woff2`, an `.svg` and an `.mp4` placed under the resolved library's `media/` and referenced from a layout via `media` are served and resolve in the rendered deck; a `.woff2` in the library's `themes/<name>/fonts/` referenced by relative `url()` from its `theme.css` is served and resolves; a `.woff2` under the library's `media/` referenced from its `theme.css` via the reserved `media:` prefix is served and resolves.
